subject: t-sc
title: T.SC.------INT.
description: First of two diagrams in ALT(FT)II-29. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'the solidification of transformational functionalism can be viewed as an important step towards uplifting the basic tone level of existence.' The crossing diagrams how trans-science structurally meets intention at the transformational-functionalism scale: T-SC (trans-science — the form's working integration of scientific and trans-rational knowledge) crossed with INT (intention — the partner-axis's actual intentional working). T-SC sits on the left with the subject-arrow; INT sits at top-center with INFO-CON (information conservation), BIA (bias), and OBS (observation) anchoring the upper-right margin as the partner-side upper outputs. C-INFO (central information) and EXP-DY (exposure dynamics) sit at center-right with INT (a second instance of intention, in the diagram's middle) and AFI (affinity insight) further down as the bridging-axis hub. POST (postulation) sits centrally below as the bridging downward hub. FUND-P (fundamental particulars) at lower-left and IF-SPT (isolated-focus spectacle) below POST with PER-DY (perceived dynamics) at center-bottom as the bridging-axis downward chain. TECH-DY (technological dynamics) anchors the bottom-left margin. Structural argument: when trans-science is crossed with intention, the upper diagonal INT → INFO-CON → BIA → OBS is the *intention-to-observation route* — intention routes through information-conservation into bias and finally into observation, the partner-side's working chain that converts trans-science into received observation. C-INFO → EXP-DY → INT (the second instance) → AFI is the bridging upper chain — central-information routes through exposure-dynamics into intention's central instance, finally producing affinity-insight. POST → FUND-P / IF-SPT / PER-DY at the bridging-bottom is what trans-science produces alone — postulation routes through fundamental-particulars into isolated-focus spectacle and perceived-dynamics. TECH-DY at the bottom-left is the subject-side terminus. The structural argument: the transformational-functionalism solidification the prose names is structurally the upper diagonal *and* the bridging C-INFO → EXP-DY → INT chain both holding — without both, trans-science routes only to TECH-DY on the subject-bottom while intention produces observation alone on the partner-side, and the form's working never reaches the AFI bridging-output.
